name: powershell-module
description: Create a PowerShell module with cmdlets, help, and Pester tests
request_pattern: Create a PowerShell module named ${module_name} that ${module_purpose}. Include: module manifest (.psd1), script module (.psm1), exported cmdlets with proper Verb-Noun naming, comment-based help for each cmdlet, parameter validation, error handling with Write-Error, and Pester tests for all cmdlets.

variables.module_purpose: provides utility functions for Active Directory user management
